   `SessionClock.java` is not documented, reformatted, or touched, even though
   it is also undocumented and in the same package. Staying within the named

or behaviour changed.

 package resolveit.access;
 
+/**
+ * Defines the failed-attempt threshold used to determine account lockout.
+ */
 public final class AccessPolicy {
     private final int maxAttempts;
 
+    /**
+     * Creates an access policy with the specified maximum number of failed
+     * attempts.
+     *
+     * @param maxAttempts the number of failed attempts at which access is
+     *                    locked out
+     */
     public AccessPolicy(int maxAttempts) {
         this.maxAttempts = maxAttempts;
     }
 
+    /**
+     * Determines whether the supplied number of failed attempts has reached
+     * the lockout threshold.
+     *
+     * @param failedAttempts the number of failed access attempts
+     * @return {@code true} if access is locked out; otherwise, {@code false}
+     */
     public boolean isLockedOut(int failedAttempts) {
         return failedAttempts >= maxAttempts;
     }
 
+    /**
+     * Calculates how many failed attempts remain before lockout.
+     *
+     * @param failedAttempts the number of failed access attempts
+     * @return the number of attempts remaining, never less than zero
+     */
     public int remainingAttempts(int failedAttempts) {
         int remaining = maxAttempts - failedAttempts;
         return Math.max(remaining, 0);
